text:
Jordan (PCorp): hi team, vendor risk needs concrete admin-audit evidence for logs/siem. can you share how admin activity is recorded and how we can export samples for their review?
Alex (AE): thanks Jordan — quick Q: what exactly does their checklist ask for? retention windows vs immutable copies?
Jordan (PCorp): both. they want admin activity trail (who did what), SIEM ingest examples, and a reproducible export we can hand to them. also prefer HMAC or signed exports if possible.
Tanya (Solutions): we can provide: 1) admin activity audit logs (console/API), 2) a nonce-signed export bundle with metadata, 3) example SIEM forward (syslog/otel) config + sample events.
Sam (Security): add that logs are KMS-encrypted at rest and we keep an append-only write-once S3 prefix for exports to preserve immutability. we can include signatures using our export tool.
Alex (AE): timeline wise — want a POC bundle for their vendor review by EOW. Jordan, is that feasible on your side?
Jordan (PCorp): EOW works if the bundle looks official. they asked for step-by-step export procedure and a .csv of admin actions.
Tanya (Solutions): example export command (runs in private control plane):
```
redwoodctl logs export --org pcorp --start 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z --end 2025-03-14T23:59:59Z --type admin_activity --dest s3://pcorp-vendor-exports/1915/ --sign-with key://redwood/export-signing-key
```
Tanya (Solutions): the command produces: metadata.json (signed), admin_actions.csv, siem_forward_sample.log, manifest.sha256. we can host the signed bundle OR publish to the customer's S3.
Sam (Security): for SIEM integration we can show a raw forward example (RFC5424 syslog) and an OTLP example. sample event: `{"ts":"2025-03-09T12:34:56Z","user":"alice@pcorp.com","action":"model.deploy","resource":"/models/m-1","result":"success"}`
Alex (AE): will include a brief README that maps exported fields to their SIG/CAIQ checks so their assessor can crosswalk.
Jordan (PCorp): can you also confirm retention periods and deletion policy? they require proof we can't tamper logs.
Sam (Security): retention: admin_activity logs retained 3 years by default, backups retained 7 years for enterprise contracts. deletion is only via audited lifecycle policy and requires two-person approval (recorded in the audit trail). export manifests are signed with our KMS-backed signing key; the signature verifies bundle integrity.
Tanya (Solutions): next steps: 1) I'll generate a signed sample bundle with 2 weeks of admin logs (sanitized) 2) Sam will add the retention & WORM notes + exported key fingerprint 3) Alex will package the README + CAIQ checklist mapping 4) deliver to Jordan's S3 by Thu afternoon.
Jordan (PCorp): perfect. can you include the command we can run to validate the signature?
Tanya (Solutions): yes — validation example: `aws s3 cp s3://pcorp-vendor-exports/1915/manifest.sha256 ./ && redwoodctl crypto verify --manifest ./manifest.sha256 --public-key key://redwood/export-verif-key`
Alex (AE): tagging @audit-bot to create an evidence ticket so we don't lose track. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: Evidence ticket created: EV-4591 (owner: Tanya).
Sam (Security): FYI — for SIEM ingestion we recommend no sampling for admin events; keep full fidelity for first 90 days, then index+compress older events. we'll document that.
Jordan (PCorp): thanks all — if the bundle contains real-looking events (sanitized) and the verification steps work, their vendor team will be satisfied. ping me once uploaded.
Alex (AE): on it — will update thread with S3 path once upload completes. :white_check_mark:
